body:
neha: Postmortem follow-up from the storage-surge writeup. We need runbook edits: consolidated triage steps, explicit escalation ladder, and a short recurring-patterns appendix. Who can pick these up?

logan: I can own the triage checklist. Goal: 8 quick checks with exact PromQL, kubectl, and a tiny verification matrix.

priya: I'll take escalation ladder and alert ownership. Need to confirm L2 backup contact lists.

neha: Also want a canonical first-responder command block so every on-call runs the same checks. Logan, include that.

logan: Draft commands to include in runbook (will format as code block in the PR):

```
# list runtime pods
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o wide
POD=$(kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
# recent evictions and warmup logs
kubectl logs -n inference $POD --since=15m | egrep "evict|kv_warm|oom"
# quick metrics
sum(rate(cache_eviction_total[1m]))
avg_over_time(kv_warmup_duration_seconds[5m])
# quick hit-rate check (Grafana saved query)
Dashboard: Inference / Cache -> Query: cache_hit_ratio
```

priya: Add these alert names so pages map correctly: AlertCacheEvictionHigh, AlertKVWarmSlow, and AlertCacheHitLow. I'll assign owners.

neha: Suggested provisional thresholds: eviction_rate > 2/min for 3m, kv_warmup_duration_seconds > 10s for 5m, cache_hit_ratio < 0.7 for 5m. I'll vet for noise before we promote.

logan: I'll open the PR for triage checklist by 2026-04-02. It will include the commands, a 5-step verification matrix, and a short smoke test to run after any routing change.

priya: Escalation ladder + contact validation by 2026-04-04. I'll update on-call entries and set alert owners in the alerting dashboard.

neha: One more runbook play: when eviction spikes AND hit < 70% => route traffic to smaller-context variant for 15m, run canary, then assess. Priya, add this to the escalation doc as a recommended mitigation step.

priya: Will do and add rollback steps and the owner for the routing action.

infra-bot: Linked postmortem -> <https://redwood.internal/postmortems/storage-surge-19611>. Actions added to tracker INC-3247. Reminder created for 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC.

neha: Summary (owner -> task -> due):
- logan: triage checklist + canonical commands + PR -> 2026-04-02
- priya: escalation ladder + alert owners + routing mitigation -> 2026-04-04
- neha: review thresholds & merge approvals -> 2026-04-06

logan: :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup: I'll ping SRE for L2 backup confirmations.

neha: Thanks everyone, this thread is the canonical action list. Please reference INC-3247 in PRs and link the runbook file path.
